title: GEODATA DWG coordinate-type field and domain
scope: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.78 places the Design coordinate type BitShort only in GEODATA object versions 2 and 3 (AutoCAD 2010+). Object version 1 uses the preceding legacy body layout and has no coordinate-type field. Modern values are restricted to 0 through 3. DXF input remains tolerant.

normativeSource.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
normativeSource.relevantText: Design coordinate type (0 unknown, 1 local grid, 2 projected grid, 3 geographic), if version is AutoCAD 2010 or later.
normativeSource.fieldOrder: For object version 1, the body proceeds from the host-block handle directly into the legacy reference-point fields. Versions 2/3 include the Design coordinate type BitShort before design point.

implementation.behavior: DRW_GeoData::encodeDwg validates coordinate types 0..3 only for object versions 2/3 and emits the field only in those versions. parseDwg reads it only for versions 2/3 and defaults the absent v1 field to zero. dwgWriter15 repeats modern-domain validation before common-state preparation, handle reservation and class registration.

regressionControl.coverage: For modern v2 DWG output, values -1 and 4 preserve sentinel-prefilled body/string/handle buffers; corrected endpoints 0 and 3 encode on the same object and buffers. The existing versioned field/tail matrix verifies v1 parsing without a coordinate-type field and v2/v3 parsing with the field. The generated high-level DWG roundtrip verifies invalid modern value 4 is refused before identity changes, corrected same-writer retry succeeds, and the emitted v2 object reads back with coordinate type 2.
regressionControl.fixturePolicy: All controls are generated locally in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

owningTest.result: failed with 16 existing ACDS/modeler and read-outcome assertions; no GEODATA or coordinate-type retry assertion failed. The same unrelated failure set was present in the prior baseline validation recorded by the neighboring GEODATA receipts.

nonClaims: No physical producer or native geospatial consumer was qualified.
The change does not qualify GEODATA ownership, whole-document graph closure, civil-tail producer behavior, projection mathematics, or native map behavior.
The test matrix's in-memory object frames validate parser alignment against the documented version gate; they are not independent producer samples.
